GitHub iot

ESP Emulator

Published 2026-05-13

An open-source emulator for ESP32 / ESP32-S3 / ESP32-C3 / ESP32-C6 SoCs that runs ESP-IDF firmware directly on a PC, eliminating repeated flashing for debugging. Maintained by Espressif, Apache 2.0 licensed.
